2 in 1 Game Pack - Spider-Man - Mysterio.name: 2 in 1 Game Pack I Spider-Man: Mysterio's Menace + X2: Wolverine's Revenge
2 in 1 Game Pack - Spider-Man - Mysterio.summary: A Marvel themed double pack featuring two games on a single cartridge.

Bee Game, The.name: The Bee Game
Bee Game, The.summary: The Bee Game lets players experience the adventures of Maya the Bee and her friend Willie as they search for their friends. A strong storm has blown through corn poppy meadow and some of the residents of the hive are now missing! Help Maya and Willie by taking on challenges and completing mini-games to find clues in the meadow, dark forest, blue pond, deep caverns and the garden to locate the other bees.

Power Rangers - Ninja Storm.name: Power Rangers: Ninja Storm
Power Rangers - Ninja Storm.summary: Evil aliens led by Lothor have attacked all the ninja academies as part of his diabolical plot to take over the earth. Only three students from the Wind Ranger Ninja Academy and two students from the Thunder Ranger Ninja Academy remain. Now these students from rival ninja academies must team up with the mysterious Green Samurai Ranger to save the world.

Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2004.name: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2004
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2004.summary: Game Boy Advance port of Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2004.
